revisions.description: Changed missing-value handling for player count filter modes from exclusion to fallback chain. Recommended mode now falls back to publisher range; Best mode falls back to recommended, then publisher. Removed redundant 'Players' label above the player count slider because the SegmentedButton already indicates the mode.
revisions.reason: User requested clearer UI (no duplicate label) and robust fallback behavior so filtering by best/recommended does not hide games that simply lack BGG community data.
revisions.author: AI

revisions.description: Fixed fallback detection for best/recommended ranges: a range is now considered present when either min OR max is non-null (previously required both). This correctly handles open-ended values like '5+' where max is null. Fehlendes min wird dabei auf 1 defaultet.
revisions.reason: Bug report: searching 'Best 4-4' matched a game whose best value was '5+' because the previous 'both non-null' check treated it as missing and fell back to recommended.
revisions.author: AI
